meta.title: Korea Trip — Seoul & Busan
meta.rule: Every value marked Verified was read on an official source (venue/operator/government tourism site) on the date above. Anything not confirmable from an official source is left blank and flagged — never inferred. Hours and prices can change; re-check the linked official page before you go.

status_legend.verified: Verified — confirmed on the linked official source
status_legend.partial: Partially verified — some fields confirmed officially, the rest blank
status_legend.conflict: Conflict — official source contradicts the itinerary (see Flagged for Review)
status_legend.unverified: Unverified — could not be confirmed from an official source; fields left blank

venues.name: N Seoul Tower — Observatory
venues.hours: Mon–Fri 10:00–22:30 · Sat–Sun & holidays 10:00–23:00 (last entry 30 min before closing). Day 2 is a Monday → closes 22:30, last entry 22:00
venues.price: Adults (13+) ₩29,000 · Children (3–12) / Seniors (65+) ₩23,000 · Under 36 months free (1 per caretaker)
venues.station: Myeong-dong Station (Line 4) — then cable car, shuttle bus 01A/01B, or walk (see Transport page)
venues.itinerary_says: Observatory 10:00-10:30 (entry until 10:00); cable car + Observatory ticket $31 each; bus ride 31 min.
notes: Itinerary hours “10:00-10:30” do not match the official hours — see flag F-03. Treat the itinerary figure as a typo only after you confirm.
Official combined cost if you also ride the cable car round-trip: ₩29,000 + ₩15,000 = ₩44,000 per adult (USD figure in itinerary not verified).
venues.source_label: N Seoul Tower (official) — Hours

venues.name: Namsan Cable Car
venues.hours: 10:00–23:00 daily (last tickets: round-trip 22:30 · one-way 22:45; may extend on busy Fri–Sun/holidays)
venues.price: Adults: round-trip ₩15,000 · one-way ₩12,000 — Children: round-trip ₩11,500 · one-way ₩9,000
venues.station: Myeong-dong Station (Line 4), Exit 3 — 10–15 min walk (official tower directions); or Exit 5 + Namsan Outdoor Escalator
venues.itinerary_says: Cable Car Hours: 10:00-10:30 (weather permitting).
notes: Itinerary hours “10:00-10:30” conflict with official 10:00–23:00 — see flag F-04.
Tickets are sold on site (operator).
venues.source_label: Visit Korea (KTO) — Namsan Cable Car listing (hours & fares)

venues.name: Namsan Outdoor Escalator (to cable car)
venues.station: Myeongdong Station Exit 5 → toward Hoehyeon Intersection, then left (official route, ~15 min to cable car)
notes: Day 2 is a Monday: if you go up before 14:00, the escalator is not running — use the Exit 3 walking route or shuttle bus 01A/01B instead. See flag F-15.
venues.source_label: YTN Seoul Tower (official) — Cable Car directions

venues.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace
venues.closed: TUESDAYS (if Tuesday is a public holiday, closed the following business day instead)
venues.price: Adults (19–64) ₩3,000 · Ages 7–18 ₩1,500 (palace office page) · Free: 6 & under, 65+ — see flag F-19 for a wording difference on the KTO page; adult price is the same on both
venues.station: Bus 01A stops at “Gyeongbokgung Palace · National Folk Museum of Korea” (official route); Anguk Station (Line 3) serves the Bukchon side — use the KTO directions link for the palace gates
venues.itinerary_says: Visit on Day 3 (Tuesday Nov 3); hours Nov–Feb 9:00–5:00, last admission 4:00; admission 3,000 KRW; guard ceremony 10:00 AM & 2:00 PM; 3–4 hours needed.
notes: ⛔ Day 3 is a Tuesday — the palace is closed and the guard ceremonies are not held. This day cannot run as written. See flag F-02 and the suggested swap.
Royal Guard Changing Ceremony (on open days): 10:00 & 14:00 · Gwanghwamun guard ceremony 11:00 & 13:00 · Public training 09:35 & 13:35 (KTO; schedule subject to change, may cancel in rain).
venues.source_label: Gyeongbokgung Palace (official) — Hours & Admissions
venues.source2_label: Visit Korea (KTO) — Gyeongbokgung Palace + Guard Ceremony listings

venues.name: Bukchon Hanok Village
venues.hours: Residential neighborhood — no general opening hours. RED ZONE (Bukchon-ro 11-gil): tourists may visit 10:00–17:00 only

transport.name: AREX Express Train (non-stop)
transport.duration: 43 min from Terminal 1 · 51 min from Terminal 2
notes: Itinerary's “45 min” roughly matches T1→Seoul Station only; “$7” matches neither the Express (₩13,000) nor All-Stop fare — see flag F-10.
From Seoul Station, Line 4 serves Myeong-dong Station, or take a short taxi to the hotel. Seoul Station connects Lines 1 & 4 and KTX (Seoul City).
transport.source_label: Seoul Metropolitan Government — Getting to Seoul from Incheon Airport

transport.name: AREX All-Stop Train
transport.route: Incheon Int'l Airport (T1/T2) → Hongik Univ. (transfer) → Euljiro 1-ga (Hotel block)
transport.duration: 59 min from Terminal 1 · 66 min from Terminal 2 (to Seoul Station; Hongik Univ. is one stop earlier)
transport.fare: ₩4,150–4,750 one-way (to Seoul Station basis, Seoul City)
notes: This is Lotte Department Store's official airport-rail directions for your hotel block: AREX → Hongik University Station → Line 2 → Euljiro 1-ga Station (Exit 7). Cheapest rail option; uses a transit card.

transport.name: Airport Limousine Bus 6015
transport.route: Incheon Int'l Airport → Myeongdong (Ibis Myeongdong Hotel stop, by Lotte/your hotel block)
transport.duration: Approx. 60–80 min (Seoul City, varies by route/traffic)
notes: Route & stops verified: 6015 = the Myeong-dong route (operator). Boarding: T1 1F No.5 / T2 B1 No.28; alight “Ibis Myeongdong Hotel” (stop 02681) — Lotte official directions.

Fare is BLANK: it is not stated in text on the operator page we could read, and Seoul City's published range (₩5,000–15,000, undated page) conflicts with current secondary reports of ₩17,000. Confirm at the airport ticket counter / operator page — see flag F-11.
Door-to-door with luggage — easiest with big suitcases, slowest in traffic.
transport.source_label: Airport Limousine Co. (official operator) — Route 6015 Myeong-dong

transport.name: Namsan Sunhwan Shuttle Bus 01A / 01B

transport.itinerary_says: Take bus to Namsan Tower — 31 min bus ride (Day 2).
notes: 01A stops at the Lotte Dept. Store main gate (stop 02140, Lotte official) — across from your hotel — and at “N SEOUL TOWER”, “Gyeongbokgung Palace · National Folk Museum”, and “Anguk Station Exit 6 · Insadong Culture Street” (official route). One bus links Days 2, 3 and 6.
The itinerary's “31 min” ride time is not from an official timetable — treat as an estimate.
transport.source_label: N Seoul Tower (official) — Getting Here by Bus

transport.name: KTX (Korail) — Seoul Station → Busan Station
transport.itinerary_says: Takes 2 hours 45 minutes; board 45 minutes early to secure luggage space.
notes: Duration and fare are BLANK: both vary by the exact train and could not be confirmed from Korail's official site in readable form during this pass. Secondary (non-official) sources report fastest ≈2h15 and a post-merger standard fare of ₩54,400 from Sep 1, 2026 — do NOT rely on these; read both off your chosen train in the official booking flow. See flag F-12.
“Board 45 min early” — no official basis was found for platform access that early; arriving at the station early with luggage is still sensible. Book at korail.com (official).

days.title: Fly SFO → Seoul · Arrive & settle in Myeongdong
days.summary: Travel day. Flight departs SFO Oct 31, arrives ICN Nov 1 (per itinerary). Airport → hotel by AREX or limousine bus, light neighborhood stroll, rest.

steps.label: Fly
steps.text: Flight SFO → Incheon Int'l Airport (ICN). Flight number, times and arrival terminal are not in the itinerary — the terminal changes your AREX time and bus platform, so add them (flag F-17).

steps.label: Airport → Hotel
steps.text: Pick one: AREX Express to Seoul Station (43 min T1 / 51 min T2, ₩13,000) then Line 4 or taxi; AREX All-Stop to Hongik Univ. → Line 2 → Euljiro 1-ga (₩4,150–4,750) — Lotte's official route to your block; or Bus 6015 to the Ibis Myeongdong stop by the hotel (fare unconfirmed — F-11).
steps.transit: Details & sources on the Transport page.

steps.label: Check in
steps.text: Stanford Hotel Myeongdong, 84 Namdaemun-ro (opposite Lotte Dept. Store). Official check-in time not confirmed — see your booking (flag F-13).

steps.label: Evening
steps.text: Light Myeongdong exploration, settle in, rest from jet lag (per itinerary). Your hotel sits on top of the district — no transit needed.

days.title: N Seoul Tower · Myeongdong shopping · Gwangjang Market
days.summary: Tower + cable car, department-store shopping (Monday hours 10:30–20:00 — confirm not a monthly closed day), food-alley evening at Gwangjang (open to 23:00).

steps.label: Late morning
steps.text: N Seoul Tower Observatory (Mon 10:00–22:30, last entry 22:00; ₩29,000/adult) + Namsan Cable Car (10:00–23:00; ₩15,000 round-trip). Combined official cost ₩44,000 per adult.
steps.transit: Bus 01A from Lotte main-gate stop (02140) across from the hotel → “N SEOUL TOWER” (₩1,500, card only, every 9 min). Or Myeong-dong Stn (Line 4) Exit 3 walk to the cable car (10–15 min). ⚠️ The outdoor escalator (Exit 5 route) is suspended Mondays 09:00–14:00.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Myeongdong shopping: Lotte Main (Mon 10:30–20:00 normal) & Shinsegae Main (Mon 10:30–20:00) — both close at 20:00 on Mondays, earlier than street shops. Confirm neither has its monthly closed day on Nov 2 (flag F-16). Olive Young / street stalls: hours unverified.
steps.transit: Walk — Lotte is opposite the hotel; Shinsegae is by Hoehyeon Stn (Line 4).

steps.label: Evening
steps.text: Gwangjang Market food alley (09:00–23:00, year-round). The general market closes 18:00 — go for the food alley. Alternative: Mangwon Market (10:00–21:00, varies by store) — but it's across the city; either/or.
steps.transit: Jonggak Stn (Line 1; 10-min walk from hotel per Lotte) → Jongno 5-ga Stn (Line 1), Exit 8 (62m to market).

steps.label: Dinner options
steps.text: Verified: Myeongdong Kyoja main branch (129 Toegye-ro — relocated 2026), 10:30–21:00. Unverified: Crystal Jade (Shinsegae basement), Pig Restaurant 2 (Itaewon — see Day 7 note), Hongojib. Bar: Sookhee (unverified).

days.title: ⛔ Gyeongbokgung Palace + Bukchon — CANNOT RUN AS WRITTEN (palace closed Tuesdays)
days.summary: The palace and its guard ceremonies do not operate on Tuesdays. Bukchon + Cafe Onion Anguk CAN run today; the palace needs another day (Day 8 is empty — see suggested swap on the Flagged page).

steps.label: ⛔ Palace
steps.text: Gyeongbokgung Palace: CLOSED Tuesdays (official). Guard Changing Ceremony (10:00/14:00 on open days) also not held. Do not go today.
steps.transit: For the replacement day: Bus 01A from Lotte main-gate stop → “Gyeongbokgung Palace · National Folk Museum” stop (official route).

steps.label: Morning (still works)
steps.text: Cafe Onion Anguk — opens 07:00 on Tuesdays (last order 21:30). Expect a queue per itinerary.
steps.transit: Anguk Stn (Line 3), Exit 3, ~3 min (official). Bus 01A also stops “Anguk Station Exit 6 · Insadong Culture Street”.

steps.text: Bukchon Hanok Village — Red Zone (Bukchon-ro 11-gil) open to tourists 10:00–17:00 only; ₩100,000 fine outside those hours (Seoul City). This rule is NOT in the itinerary (flag F-14).

steps.label: Unplanned slots
steps.text: “Lunch near palace” and “traditional tea house” name no venues — unverifiable until named.

days.title: Seongsu (“Brooklyn of Seoul”) — cafes & shopping
days.summary: Line 2 direct to Seongsu. Only Cafe Onion Seongsu is verified among today's stops; DDP belongs to Dongdaemun, not this neighborhood (flag F-06).

steps.label: Get there
steps.text: Euljiro 1-ga (Line 2) → Seongsu Station (Line 2) — direct, no transfer (both stations verified on official pages). Ride time not officially verified.

steps.label: Brunch (unverified)
steps.text: Solsot stone-pot rice — itinerary says arrive before opening ($7–$14). Opening time unverified; pin the branch in Naver Map first.

steps.label: Verified anchor
steps.text: Cafe Onion Seongsu: Wed 08:00–22:00 (last order 21:30), 8 Achasan-ro 9-gil — 5 min from Seongsu Stn Exit 2.

steps.label: Unverified list
steps.text: Hanjungsun (mochi) · caricature (unnamed) · Eternalog photo booth · Blue Elephant · Cafe Far Ben · Rain Report (see F-07) · Jayeondo salt bread · Musinsa Standard (written “Musina”) · Marge Sherwood · Ader Error · Brandy Melville — none verified from official sources yet.

steps.label: ⚠️ DDP
steps.text: Dongdaemun Design Plaza is listed today but sits in Dongdaemun (281 Eulji-ro, Jung-gu), 10:00–20:00 — a separate stop, not part of Seongsu. Decide: DDP or Seongsu depth.

steps.label: Evening (unverified)
steps.text: Break Silence (R&B/cocktails); dinner Chuncheongol Dakgalbi or “Uri Wang Galbitang” (its itinerary location line conflicts — F-08).

days.title: Gangnam — Starfield COEX Mall & Gangnam Style statue
days.summary: Light day in Gangnam: mall (10:30–22:00), the statue outside the east gate, and (verified add-on) Starfield Library.

steps.label: Get there
steps.text: Euljiro 1-ga (Line 2) → Samseong Station (Line 2) — direct. Itinerary says 47 min subway; duration unverified.
steps.transit: Line 2 — Bongeunsa Stn (Line 9) also serves COEX.

steps.label: At COEX
steps.text: Starfield COEX Mall 10:30–22:00 (official). “Soul Market” pastries/coffee: tenant could not be identified officially (flag F-20). Starfield Library (B1, free, 10:30–22:00) added as a verified option.

steps.label: Photo
steps.text: Gangnam Style statue at COEX East Gate Plaza — 3 min from Samseong Stn Exit 6 (Visit Gangnam). Outdoor plaza; no official hours published.

days.title: Ikseon-dong & Insadong
days.summary: Hanok-alley food day in Jongno. None of today's venues are verified yet — they're small independents without official pages we could confirm.

steps.label: Get there
steps.text: Bus 01A from Lotte main-gate stop → “Anguk Station Exit 6 · Insadong Culture Street” (official route, ₩1,500). Anguk Stn (Line 3) anchors the area.
steps.transit: Bus 01A (₩1,500 card) or subway to Anguk (Line 3).

steps.label: Eat (unverified)
steps.text: Chwihyang / “Favorite of Ikseon” — pork belly rose pasta ($14.50 per itinerary). Possibly one restaurant written two ways (flag F-08).

steps.label: Cafes (unverified)
steps.text: Rain Report Cafe “in Insadong” (also listed under Seongsu Day 4 — F-07) · Jayeondo Saltbread & House ($8.77/4 per itinerary).

days.title: Itaewon — NO DETAILS IN ITINERARY
days.summary: The itinerary names the neighborhood only — no venues, times, or transit. Nothing to verify yet (flag F-17).

steps.label: Open day
steps.text: Only cross-reference: “Pig Restaurant 2 — Itaewon” is filed under Day 2. If it belongs here, move it and it can be verified once confirmed.

days.title: — EMPTY DAY —
days.summary: Blank in the itinerary. Best candidate to receive the Gyeongbokgung Palace plan displaced from Tuesday (suggested swap — needs your approval).

steps.label: Suggested use
steps.text: Move Day 3's palace plan here: Sun hours 09:00–17:00 (last admission 16:00), guard ceremonies 10:00 & 14:00 (KTO, rain may cancel). Note: Gwangjang general market is closed Sundays (food alley open) if you shuffle food plans; Cafe Onion Anguk opens 09:00 on Sundays.
steps.transit: Bus 01A Lotte main-gate stop → “Gyeongbokgung Palace · National Folk Museum”.

days.title: Seoul → Busan (KTX) · Haeundae evening
days.summary: Check out, KTX to Busan, taxi to Haeundae, beach walk + market dinner (market to 22:00). KTX time/fare must come from your Korail booking.

steps.label: Morning
steps.text: Check out of Stanford Hotel Myeongdong. Itinerary: leave by 10:00, checkout “by 12:00” — official checkout time unconfirmed (flag F-13). Note: Lotte Dept. Store across the street is CLOSED Mon Nov 9 (official) — no last-minute department-store run.
steps.transit: Taxi to Seoul Station (per itinerary) or Line 4: Myeong-dong/Hoehyeon → Seoul Station.

steps.label: KTX
steps.text: Seoul Station → Busan Station. Duration & fare: read off your booked train at korail.com (unverified here — flag F-12). Itinerary's 2h45 is train-dependent.
steps.transit: Korail KTX — official booking link on Transport page.

steps.label: Arrive Busan
steps.text: Taxi to L7 Haeundae (per itinerary). Hotel check-in time/address not verified from the official page yet (see Hotels page).

steps.label: Evening
steps.text: Walk toward Haeundae Beach; Haeundae Traditional Market (09:00–22:00, varies by store) for hotteok, tteokbokki, mandu, fried chicken, seafood.

irregularities.title: Year typo: “Nov 2, 2006”
irregularities.detail: Every weekday label in the itinerary matches 2026 exactly (Nov 1 = Sunday … Nov 9 = Monday). In 2006, Nov 2 was a Thursday. This site uses 2026 dates, labeled as assumed.
irregularities.action: Confirm the trip year is 2026.

irregularities.title: Gyeongbokgung Palace scheduled on its closed day
irregularities.detail: Day 3 is Tuesday Nov 3. The palace's official site and KTO both state: closed Tuesdays; guard ceremonies are not held that day either. The itinerary even quotes the Tuesday closure yet still schedules the visit.
irregularities.action: Approve a day swap (Day 8 Sunday is empty) or pick another open day. Suggested fix S-1.

irregularities.title: N Seoul Tower hours wrong in itinerary
irregularities.detail: Itinerary: “Observatory 10:00-10:30 (entry until 10:00)”. Official: weekdays 10:00–22:30, weekends/holidays 10:00–23:00, last entry 30 min before close, open 365 days.
irregularities.action: Use official hours; Monday last entry is 22:00.

irregularities.title: Cable car hours wrong in itinerary
irregularities.detail: Itinerary: “10:00-10:30”. Official/KTO: 10:00–23:00 daily (last round-trip ticket 22:30). Adult round-trip ₩15,000.
irregularities.action: Use official hours.

irregularities.title: Gwangjang Market hours wrong in itinerary
irregularities.detail: Itinerary: “9:00-11:00pm, some stalls until 2am”. Official (Visit Seoul/KTO): market 09:00–18:00 (closed Sundays); food alley 09:00–23:00 daily; gujé street 10:00–19:00 (closed Sundays). No official support for 2am stalls.
irregularities.action: Plan the food alley before 23:00; Monday all sections open.

irregularities.title: DDP filed under Seongsu with Seongsu's description
irregularities.detail: Dongdaemun Design Plaza is at 281 Eulji-ro, Jung-gu (Dongdaemun), hours 10:00–20:00. The “converted warehouses / pop-ups / bakeries” text describes Seongsu-dong. Two different areas on one day may be doable, but not as one walkable cluster.
irregularities.action: Decide: keep DDP as a separate leg or remove from Day 4.

irregularities.title: Rain Report Cafe listed in two neighborhoods
irregularities.detail: Day 4 (Seongsu cafe list) and Day 6 (“Rain Report Cafe in Insadong”). No official source verified either branch.
irregularities.action: Confirm intended branch; then verify hours.

irregularities.title: Merged/duplicate restaurant notes (Days 4 & 6)
irregularities.detail: “Uri Wang Galbitang located in Gangdong. Favorite of Ikseon-dong” mixes two distant areas; “Chwihyang” and “Favorite of Ikseon” share the same signature dish (pork belly rose pasta) — likely one restaurant under two names.
irregularities.action: Confirm the real restaurant name(s) + branch; then verify.

irregularities.title: Name spellings that will break map searches
irregularities.detail: Namsun→Namsan Tower; Myeongdog→Myeongdong; Starfiel→Starfield; “Musina”→presumed Musinsa; Limosine→Limousine bus. Search corrected spellings in Naver Map. Site shows “as written” names next to corrected ones.
irregularities.action: Adopt corrected names in your notes.

irregularities.title: AREX “45 min, $7” doesn't match official fares
irregularities.detail: Official (Seoul City): Express 43 min (T1)/51 min (T2), ₩13,000; All-Stop 59/66 min, ₩4,150–4,750. “$7” matches neither; “45 min” only fits T1 Express.
irregularities.action: Budget ₩13,000 (Express) or ~₩4,750 (All-Stop).

irregularities.title: Airport limousine bus fare unconfirmed
irregularities.detail: Route 6015 (Myeong-dong) and stops are verified on the operator's official site (T1 1F No.5 / T2 B1 No.28 → Ibis Myeongdong). The fare is not published in readable text there; Seoul City's undated ₩5,000–15,000 range conflicts with secondary reports of ₩17,000. Itinerary says $13.
irregularities.action: Confirm fare at the ICN ticket counter / operator timetable before budgeting.

irregularities.title: KTX duration & fare unverified; “board 45 min early” unfounded officially
irregularities.detail: Duration (₩ fare too) depends on the exact train — neither could be read from korail.com in this pass, so both are blank on this site. Secondary sources (Sep 2026 KTX-SRT merger reports) cite ≈2h15 fastest and ₩54,400 standard — treat as unconfirmed until seen in Korail booking. No official source supports 45-minute-early boarding.
irregularities.action: Book at korail.com; copy your train's exact times into Day 9.

irregularities.title: Stanford Hotel check-in/out not on official site text
irregularities.detail: Address (84 Namdaemun-ro) verified from the hotel's official FAQ. Check-in/check-out times weren't retrievable from the official site; the itinerary's “check out by 12:00pm” is therefore unverified here (third-party listings agree, but per protocol they're not published as fact).
irregularities.action: Confirm times on your booking confirmation.

irregularities.title: Bukchon tourist curfew missing from itinerary
irregularities.detail: Seoul City: Bukchon Red Zone (Bukchon-ro 11-gil) — tourists 10:00–17:00 only, restricted 17:00–10:00, fine ₩100,000, enforced since Mar 1, 2025. An after-lunch wander that drifts past 17:00 risks a fine.
irregularities.action: Schedule Bukchon lanes 10:00–17:00.

irregularities.title: Namsan outdoor escalator closed Monday mornings
irregularities.detail: Official (YTN Seoul Tower): escalator suspended Mondays 09:00–14:00 for inspection. Day 2 is Monday — the Exit 5 + escalator route to the cable car won't work before 14:00. Use Exit 3 walk or bus 01A/01B.
irregularities.action: Go via bus 01A or after 14:00.

irregularities.title: Department-store monthly closed day — Nov 2 unconfirmed
irregularities.detail: Korean department stores close on scheduled days. Lotte Main's official page (checked Oct 21) shows “Closed: Monday, 09 Nov.” — proving Monday closures happen. Whether Mon Nov 2 (Day 2 shopping) is a closed or extended day could not be extracted from Lotte's calendar widget; Shinsegae also “varies by month” (KTO).
irregularities.action: Check both official store calendars for Nov 2 before the trip.

irregularities.title: Itinerary gaps: Days 7–8, Busan days, flights
irregularities.detail: Day 7 (Itaewon) has no venues; Day 8 is blank; no Busan sightseeing days after Nov 9; no return flight/departure plan; inbound flight number/terminal/times absent (affects AREX choice and Day 1). Also “Pig Restaurant 2 (Itaewon)” filed under Day 2 may belong on Day 7.
irregularities.action: Fill in or approve suggestions; add flight details.

irregularities.title: Myeongdong Kyoja main branch moved (2026)
irregularities.detail: The restaurant's official site states the main restaurant is now at 129 Toegye-ro, Jung-gu after a 2026 relocation. KTO's English listing still shows the old 29 Myeongdong 10-gil address (its Korean text shows Toegye-ro 129).
irregularities.action: Navigate to 129 Toegye-ro; ignore old-address pins.

irregularities.title: Palace free-admission wording differs by source
irregularities.detail: Palace office English page: ages 7–18 pay ₩1,500, free = 6 & under and 65+. KTO page: “Free for those under 19 years old over 65”. Adult (19–64) price ₩3,000 is identical on both — no impact for two adults.
irregularities.action: None needed for this party.

irregularities.title: “Soul Market” (COEX) unidentified
irregularities.detail: No tenant by this name could be confirmed from official COEX information in this pass. Possible name error or temporary pop-up.
irregularities.action: Confirm the shop's exact name; mall hours (10:30–22:00) are verified regardless.

irregularities.title: All USD prices in the itinerary are unverified
irregularities.detail: $31 tower bundle, $10 BBQ, $7–14 Solsot, $8.77 salt bread, $14.50 pasta, etc. No exchange-rate source was used; this site publishes official KRW amounts where verified and leaves the rest blank.
irregularities.action: Budget in KRW from official prices.

irregularities.title: Cosmetic: Day 9 numbering repeats “1.”
irregularities.detail: Original list numbering only — no content impact. Preserved verbatim in itinerary-original.md.
irregularities.action: None.

suggestions.title: Swap the palace plan from Tue Nov 3 → Sun Nov 8
suggestions.detail: Day 8 is empty. On Sunday the palace runs 09:00–17:00 with guard ceremonies 10:00 & 14:00 (KTO, weather permitting). Keep Bukchon on either day but within 10:00–17:00; note Cafe Onion Anguk opens 09:00 on Sundays (07:00 weekdays) and Gwangjang's general market closes Sundays if food plans move too.

suggestions.title: Use Bus 01A as your sightseeing spine
suggestions.detail: One official ₩1,500 loop links your hotel block (Lotte main gate, stop 02140) to N Seoul Tower, Gyeongbokgung Palace, and Anguk/Insadong — covering Days 2, 3 and 6 without subway transfers.

suggestions.title: Do the tower late-afternoon → sunset on Day 2
suggestions.detail: Escalator back in service after 14:00 Mondays; observatory open to 22:30 (last entry 22:00), so a sunset/night visit fits after shopping (stores close 20:00 Mondays). Cable-car tickets sold on site; queues possible — no official wait data.

suggestions.title: Name the unnamed venues, then they get verified
suggestions.detail: Tea house (Day 3), palace lunch (Day 3), caricature studio (Day 4), and branch choices for Solsot/Dakgalbi/Musinsa etc. Once named, each can be checked against official pages or clearly remain flagged.
